title: Absorbent and good value.
text: Absorbent and good value.. These are nice.  They are very absorbent.  The four starts is because they could be a little thicker.  I love the color and print.  They are very easy to use and I feel a good value for under $4. each.  There is a button and a loop to hold the towel in place and it does a good job.

product_metadata.title: DII 3 - Piece Microfiber Adjustable Plush Printed Spa Bath Hair Wrap, Towel for College Dorms, Pools, Gyms, Beaches, Locker Rooms, Bathroom, 55.5 x 32.5 - Gray Lattice
features: FAST DRY TO SAVE YOUR TIME: The microfiber hair wrap material absorbs up to seven times its weight in water, perfect for helping hair dry and get yourself ready in time
EASY TO WEAR: Simply put hair wrap over your hair and twist the extra material around your hair and secure in place by placing the elastic band around the button
LIGHT WEIGHT, COMFORTABLE and ULTRA-ABSORBENT: Hair wrap is made of super soft microfiber, provide the smooth touch feeling and can absorb extra water
SUITABLE FOR DIFFERENT ACTIVITIES AND PLACES: Wrap yourself after shower at gym, college dorms, pools, beaches, locker rooms, bathrooms; easy to carry in bag for many activities
CARE TIPS: Hair Wrap is Machine Washable, wash with Cold Water, Tumble Dry, Do Not use bleach or fabric softener
